asr.full_text: So, this one-two setup, I mean we talked about it I think in the last livestream, it's holding here support. I mean Solana, no not Solana Polygon is holding support. It's between 16 cents and 18.6 cents, this first micro support area, but the price formed also here on the Coinbase chart, a new local low in October, I can see this potentially as A wave up then A, B, C down in Wave B. And then, it's a possible one to set up, now we need to see some upside momentum and it could fill in this C wavewave of wave-4 that might happen in November. If we break decisively above $0.39, it will have another chance to maybe form something more bullish. But to be honest, because of the local low, it would need to start from scratch. So the bullish alternative would be five waves up in wave-1, and then if it can hold a higher loa afterwards then we have a one two set up, but it basically formed a new cycle loa. As I said, there is nothing bullish about Polygon really. It has to form proper five wave move up and a three wave pullback to confirm to us that a meaningful loa has formed. And actually this is even too small because I would need to see the next larger degree form, but it would be a good start, this 1.2 setup. At the moment, we are even one smaller degree down here, very much in the beginning of a potential uptrend. But obviously, needless to say, it needs to hold that $0.161 level, yeah. In the very short term, it's looking similar to what many other coins are doing but I haven't seen really much upside momentum. Again, it might be another one-two set up but this is all very speculative. I think the next week could be very important also here for Polygon and many other coins. If we can get some further upside momentum then the next important resistance level here will be also where that selling pressure started to come in on 10th of October which was around 144 dollars. So I think next week could be important for Polygon. It might have bottomed. But the 4.50 dollar level is gonna be a very very meaningful one. Everything below is just range-bound, I think. So let's see if we can break above this 4.50 dollar level. So let's see if we can break above this 4.50 dollar level.
